_comment: Pin the EXACT archive.org recording(s) for a mantra when auto-search picks the wrong one, or when you want specific tracks. Key = the mantra's slug (see lib/aliases.js). Value = an archive.org item id, a details/download URL, or — MOST RELIABLE — a direct .mp3 URL (https://archive.org/download/<item>/<file>.mp3, needs NO live lookup so it can never fail mid-build). Value can ALSO be an ARRAY of any of those to pin MULTIPLE recitations — they become the feeds for this mantra, in order, and 'another voice' cycles through them. Pins ALWAYS win and re-resolve every build; a pin that can't resolve is left for retry (never replaced by a search result). Bare item ids need a metadata call that archive.org can rate-limit on a big run, so re-run if one comes up empty. Re-run: node scripts/build-audio-index.cjs. Lines starting with _ are ignored.
